blurb: Jerry Porter Massage Therapies offers personalized massage treatments including deep tissue, sports, pre-natal/pregnancy, and relaxation/Swedish massage. The therapist uses various techniques to address muscle tension, injuries, and promote relaxation. Services are based in the Seattle neighborhood of Queen Anne and include treatment for auto and L&I injuries.
